metadata.question: Was the number of fire detections in Pantanal, Brazil on June 11, 2024, greater than the number detected in any June from 2000 to 2023, as observed with MODIS Aqua?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Collection: MODIS Aqua fire detections (MOD14A1 or MCD14DL - MODIS thermal anomalies/fire) - Date: June 11, 2024 vs. June 1-30 for years 2000-2023 - Location: Pantanal biome, Brazil (approximately -19 to -22 latitude, -56 to -60 longitude) - Need to count fire pixels/detections per date range 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Fire detection data doesn't need cloud masking in the traditional sense; we're looking at fire confidence/thermal anomalies - Use MODIS confidence band to filter high-confidence detections - Count valid fire detections (pixels with confidence >= 30 or similar threshold) 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid Zero (A/B): 0 fires detected (legitimate result) - C1: No MODIS data available for the region/dates - C2: Data exists but no valid fire pixels after filtering - C3: Calculation fails (null result, invalid range) - Compare: June 11, 2024 count vs. max count in any June (2000-2023) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Pantanal region (Brazil) const pantanal = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-60.5, -19], [-56, -19], [-56, -22], [-60.5, -22], [-60.5, -19]] ]); // MODIS Aqua fire data (MCD14DL - daily fire detection) const modisCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14DL'); // 1. Get June 11, 2024 data const june11_2024 = modisCollection .filterDate('2024-06-11', '2024-06-12') .filterBounds(pantanal); const count_2024 = june11_2024.size().getInfo(); if (count_2024 === 0) { console.log("No MODIS Aqua data for June 11, 2024"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Extract fire detections for June 11, 2024 const fireDetections_2024 = june11_2024 .map(img => img.select(['Confidence']).gte(30)) // Confidence >= 30 .reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()); const fireCount_2024 = fireDetections_2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: pantanal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val_2024 = fireCount_2024['Confidence'] || 0; console.log(`June 11, 2024 Fire Detections: ${val_2024}`); // 2. Get max fire detections for any June (2000-2023) let maxFireCount = 0; let maxYear = null; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2023; year++) { const startDate = `${year}-06-01`; const endDate = `${year}-06-30`; const juneData = modisCollection .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(pantanal); const yearCount = juneData.size().getInfo(); if (yearCount === 0) { console.log(`June ${year}: No data (C1)`); continue; } const fireDetections = juneData .map(img => img.select(['Confidence']).gte(30)) .reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()); const fireResult = fireDetections.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: pantanal, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const fireVal = fireResult['Confidence'] || 0; if (fireVal > maxFireCount) { maxFireCount = fireVal; maxYear = year; } } if (maxFireCount === null || maxFireCount === undefined) { console.log("Failed to calculate historical max"); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Historical Max (June 2000-2023): ${maxFireCount} in June ${maxYear}`); console.log(`June 11, 2024 vs Max: ${val_2024} vs ${maxFireCount}`); if (val_2024 > maxFireCount) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
